svg.title: System context
svg.desc: The one-glance picture for newcomers and stakeholders: every displayed value is derived — 20+ upstream connectors feed a scheduled ETL into the platform's stores, which the app serves to the public and to authenticated staff editors. Dashed violet arrows are the few flows that run the other way. Third-party sources live here, in context, rather than in a diagram of their own.
